text:
sara: FYI, us-west1-b reports exhausted A100 capacity in compute-gpu-dedicated nodepool. Pending GPU pods = ~42, oldest pending ~12m. Can we trigger cross-cluster fallback?
kevin: saw the alert. autoscaler didn't get spare quota, kept pending. kube events show failed scheduling due to 'NoNodesAvailable' on gpu-type=a100.
maria: @sara which workloads are pending? are these customer-dedicated or internal eval jobs?
sara: majority are customer-prod requests on model-serving-prod (dedicated). small fraction is nightly eval.
lee: quick note: us-west1-b has provider quota but also physical AZ capacity issues reported by infra provider. They won't fulfill new A100s in next 24-48h.
devon: can we spin up us-west2 cluster and route some requests there? latency hit ~30-60ms extra but better than queuing. Also mentions VPN egress costs.
kevin: we have two constraints: (1) infra quota + AZ shortage, (2) autoscaler config only scales within cluster. Need cross-cluster orchestration at routing layer (reconcile service registry + fallback policy).
autoscaler-bot: [INFO] 2026-06-12T19:14:32Z scaled up nodepool-gpu-us-west1-c by +3 nodes (a100-40gb).
maria: Suggestion: proactive pre-warm in us-west2 with minimal on-demand reserved nodes, and failover policy that prefers pre-warmed nodes before spinning new preemptibles. Keeps tail latency predictable.
sara: Agree. Proposed plan: 1) mark us-west1-b nodepool as 'at-risk' in infra console, 2) enable routing fallback policy 'cross-cluster-gpu' that sends 20% of new allocation to us-west2 until us-west1 capacity recovers, 3) pre-warm 8 GPUs in us-west2 nodepool.
lee: Implementation detail: add taint to us-west2 pre-warm nodes: `gpu-failover=prewarm:NoSchedule` and add toleration to serving deployments. That prevents accidental placement when normal pool healthy.
kevin: Autoscaler config snippet we should apply (cluster-autoscaler flags):
```
--balance-similar-node-groups=true
--expander=least-waste
--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false
--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m
```
This plus node group weights should prefer pre-warm groups.
maria: Also add a routing policy change in the API gateway: `if (zone.unhealthy || pendingQueue>10) route -> fallbackCluster` for model-serving-prod route. Simple rollout: 10% -> 50% over 15m.
devon: cost tradeoff: on-demand pre-warm = ~$X/hr per A100 vs preemptible much cheaper but can be reclaimed. For SLA customers use on-demand reserved capacity. For non-SLA jobs use preemptible fallback.
sara: Action items: @lee create tainted prewarm nodepool in us-west2 (8 GPUs) by 20:30 PT. @kevin update cluster-autoscaler flags & node-group weights. @maria add gateway fallback policy and test with 10% canary. @devon estimate cost delta and prepare exec summary for support.
lee: Starting nodepool create now. command: `gcloud container node-pools create gpu-prewarm --cluster=rw-west2-prod --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=1 --node-taints=gpu-failover=prewarm:NoSchedule --num-nodes=2 --min-nodes=2 --max-nodes=8`
kevin: I'll patch CA and apply controlled rollout. Also will add a k8s-level priorityClass for critical serving pods so they preempt eval jobs rather than getting blocked.
maria: Will add gateway change to staging and run synthetic traffic test against fallback cluster. Expect higher tail latency but should keep P95 under 600ms.
devon: Cost estimate attached (short): prewarm 8 A100 on-demand ~ $Y/day; preemptible option ~ 0.4*Y/day but with eviction risk. I'll put numbers in the doc and tag @finance.
sara: Nice. If provider confirms AZ replenishment within 24h we will scale down pre-warm gradually. Otherwise escalate to reserved capacity negotiations.
kevin: Also let's add a short-lived metric in console 'cross_cluster_fallback_rate' to track percent of allocation hitting fallback. Set alert at >30% for 1h.
lee: Nodepool creation succeeded, 4 nodes ready in us-west2 prewarm group.
autoscaler-bot: [INFO] 2026-06-12T19:41:09Z nodepool gpu-prewarm (us-west2) registered 4 nodes.
sara: Thanks. Rolling canary 10% now. Watch pending queue and errors.
maria: Canary traffic injected. No 5xxs so far. Latency +38ms p50, p95 +120ms.
sara: Early metrics good. Keep monitoring. If pending drops below 5 for 15m we reduce fallback to 0% and scale down pre-warm nodes to min 2.
kevin: Will implement autoscale-to-min after 30m of stable <5 pending.
devon: I'll file the exec summary for finance and customer ops.
sara: Great coordination. Follow-ups: postmortem if provider doesn't restore AZ capacity in 48h, and add cross-cluster runbook. :+1:
